verdict.rationale: dlt/dltHub explicitly document scheduling recurring pipeline runs — 'Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs' via `dlthub deploy`, 'teams schedule, backfill, and chain their pipelines with dltHub', and 'Schedule lineage-aware pipeline runs with agents' — plus deployment guides for Airflow and GitHub Actions (cron-based scheduling) for running pipelines anywhere Python runs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that scheduling works reliably in production and more detail on native cron/interval configuration beyond third-party orchestrators.
